zh.title: 美國安檢最久機場排名：甘迺迪機場平均23.1分鐘居首，歐海爾20.2分鐘次之
zh.summary: Travel Bulletin針對美國50座最繁忙機場的研究顯示，2026年夏季安檢平均等候時間為9.9分鐘，其中紐約甘迺迪機場以23.1分鐘居首，芝加哥歐海爾機場20.2分鐘、紐華克17.9分鐘、安克拉治16.3分鐘隨後；休士頓布希機場13.6分鐘在排名中名列第六，僅差一步躋身前五。
body: 這項研究檢視美國50座最繁忙機場，以MyTSA應用程式的歷史估計與運輸安全管理局的旅客吞吐量為依據，涵蓋6月中旬至8月中旬約8週的時間，50座機場的平均安檢等候時間為9.9分鐘，各機場之間差異明顯。

紐約甘迺迪機場以23.1分鐘居首，超過整體平均的兩倍，每小時約4,282人次通過安檢，僅次於洛杉磯機場的約4,306人次；芝加哥歐海爾機場20.2分鐘居次，每小時約4,216.7人次；紐華克自由機場17.9分鐘第三，每小時約3,040人次；安克拉治機場16.3分鐘第四，每小時約516.7人次，為受檢機場中最低，卻仍遠高於平均。休士頓布希機場13.6分鐘在排名中名列第六，雖未進入前五，仍比9.9分鐘的整體平均高出3.7分鐘。
文章提醒，安檢等候時間會隨出發時刻、航廈與旅客同時抵達的情形而波動，歷史平均僅供規劃參考，不能保證特定日期的實際等候時間；旅客應預留時間並依航空公司建議提早抵達，尤其在行李託運或轉機行程緊湊時更須留意。

en.title: Longest US airport security lines in 2026: JFK tops the ranking at 23.1 minutes
en.summary: A Travel Bulletin study of the 50 busiest US airports found an average security wait of 9.9 minutes in summer 2026, with New York's JFK longest at 23.1 minutes, followed by Chicago O'Hare at 20.2, Newark at 17.9 and Anchorage at 16.3 minutes; Houston's Bush airport, at 13.6 minutes, ranked sixth and narrowly missed the top five.
body: The study examined security wait times at 50 of the busiest airports in the US, using historical estimates from the MyTSA app alongside Transportation Security Administration passenger throughput figures, covering about eight weeks between mid-June and mid-August. The overall average across the 50 airports was 9.9 minutes, with substantial differences between airports.

New York John F. Kennedy International Airport recorded the longest average wait at 23.1 minutes, more than twice the overall average, processing about 4,282 passengers per hour through security, second only to Los Angeles at about 4,306. Chicago O'Hare followed at 20.2 minutes and about 4,216.7 passengers per hour, Newark Liberty at 17.9 minutes and about 3,040 per hour, and Ted Stevens Anchorage at 16.3 minutes and about 516.7 per hour, the lowest volume in the study yet well above the average. Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport averaged 13.6 minutes, ranking sixth, 3.7 minutes above the overall figure.

The article cautions that waits fluctuate with departure schedules, terminals and simultaneous arrivals, so a historical average is a planning reference rather than a guarantee for any particular day; travellers should allow extra time and follow airline arrival guidance, especially with checked baggage or tight connections.
